meta.name: meeting
meta.description: Process raw meeting notes into structured meeting note with in-repo tasks

copy.tagline: 把原始会议记录整理成结构化笔记和任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常开会需要自动整理笔记和待办事项
copy.tagline_en: Turn raw meeting notes into structured notes and tasks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to organize meeting notes and action items automatically

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你把杂乱的会议笔记整理成结构化的会议记录，并自动提取你的待办事项添加到任务清单中。
howto.when: 当你提供会议笔记文件路径、粘贴笔记内容，或输入“browse”浏览未处理的会议文件时触发。

say.text: 浏览 Meetings 文件夹中未处理的会议文件
say.note: Claude 会列出未处理的会议文件供你选择。

say.text: 粘贴会议笔记：今天讨论了新功能上线计划，决定下周一发布，张三负责测试。
say.note: Claude 会分析文本并生成会议记录和待办事项。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can turn messy meeting notes into structured meeting records and extract your action items to add to the task list.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a meeting note file path, paste note text, or type 'browse' to list unprocessed meeting files.

say_en.text: Process my meeting notes from this afternoon, file is Meetings/2025-03-21 Discussion.md
say_en.note: Claude will read the file and generate a structured meeting note.

say_en.text: Browse unprocessed meeting files in the Meetings folder
say_en.note: Claude will list unprocessed meeting files for you to choose.
